name: cake-eat
comment: BlockCake: use_item on a fresh cake six times (t=1..6) and once on a cake at meta 3 holding a stick (t=7). The harness player has full health (20), so eatCakeSlice (health < 20) neither heals nor eats: blockActivated still returns true (placed true, swingItem). t=8 removes the stone under the second cake (onNeighborBlockChange: canBlockStay needs a solid material below; it drops nothing, quantityDropped 0, and vanishes); a cake set in the air at (6, 63, 2) stays until t=9 sets stone above it, then goes the same way. block_box, rng_state.
